// RED PROBE for the transport-universe guard in
// tests/unit/notification-bus-invariants.test.ts ("outbound transports…").
//
// This is the exact shape of the defect the guard exists to refuse: a new
// send path that imports a transport directly — statically AND dynamically —
// and is classified nowhere, so the §9.5 cadence gate (the customer's global
// off switch and monthly ceiling) never sees the send. The guard test feeds
// this file through the SAME detector it runs over the real tree and asserts
// it comes back flagged; if the detector ever stops seeing it, the guard is
// no longer guarding.

import { sendEmail } from "@/lib/email/email-service"

export async function remindQuietly(to: string) {
    // A well-meaning engagement nudge, sent behind the dispatcher's back.
    await sendEmail({ to, subject: "Μια υπενθύμιση", html: "<p>…</p>" })

    // The dynamic form the admin actions use — same specifier, no import
    // statement, so a statement-level scan would miss it.
    const { sendWebPush } = await import("@/lib/push/web-push")
    void sendWebPush
}
